scope: Synchronized Network.step with external-input upload and spike readback; excludes topology compilation, world, SSE, rendering, and OS power measurement

protocols.sparse: bias=0, threshold=100, leak=0.02, refractory=2, reset potential; constant input 125 into 1% of neurons chosen uniformly without replacement, seed=123; high threshold prevents recurrent avalanches

order: Alternate CPU/GPU within each repetition; each device starts from identical seed/state
